about: Hand-maintained corrections applied by tools/catalog/build_catalog.py on top of items_research.json. 'provisional_footprint' values are PLANNING PLACEHOLDERS chosen by the editor team, not facts; such items stay flagged footprint_status=unknown in the app until a real source is recorded here with 'footprint' + 'footprint_status'. 'landmark'/'landmarks' mark catalogue entries that duplicate a fixed world landmark (drawn by the map; never placeable, hidden from the palette, kept so old layouts migrate); 'scope' marks items that exist outside the main farm (e.g. 'fishing_lake'; reference only).

Field.note: No wiki states the field size; 2013 client data cited in PLACEMENT_RESEARCH.md places one field per tile (1x1). Unverified against the current game.

Slat fence.note: Category corrected from path to fence (W5): the RU name 'Doshchataya ograda' means plank fence, its art is a fence set (pole / straight / corner pieces), and the client's own tables list it with the fences (private check of the user's client files; strong). The community list had it under paths.
